hook: A weight exists where an entire function looks small yet stays a positive distance from all polynomials
summary: This paper answers a question of Borichev in the negative. The authors construct a growing weight and an entire function of zero exponential type that is small relative to the weight, yet cannot be approximated by polynomials in the weighted norms. The result is a specific counterexample and says nothing about how common such weights are.
title: A Counterexample to Polynomial Approximation for Monotone Weights
